state: JevCode content acquisition decision, round 11. The operator found a QMuse-hosted page titled 'JEV 模型，正在被用来做什么' (what Jev is being used for) — a curated collection of 202 Twitter/X posts about Jev use cases, built by someone else on the QMuse platform. The full dataset has been extracted from the page's JS bundle: 202 tweet entries, each with author, date (2026-09-15 to 09-18), original English text, machine translation to zh-CN (low quality in places, e.g. mistranslating a metaphor as '犹太民主党把我送进了兔子洞'), engagement metrics (views 4 to 34.6M), links, media, hashtags. The operator wants to: replicate the creative concept, do large-scale inclusion of this content, ideally replicate the whole site's content. Legal/ethical considerations: the underlying tweets are public posts by their authors; the collection itself is someone else's curated work (selection and arrangement has compilation copyright in some jurisdictions); the zh translations in the bundle are machine translations of others' tweets. JevCode already has a docs/recipes site; a 'community pulse / what people are building with Jev' section is strategically adjacent to the existing ecosystem page (GitHub projects) — round 1 rated ecosystem content highly. Options: A) build our own tweet-collection page ingesting the extracted 202 tweets verbatim (full replication); B) build a community-pulse page but only using entries that pass a value gate (e.g. views >= threshold or contains a project link), with attribution to original authors and links back to the original tweets, not replicating the collection's translations (write our own zh summaries); C) do not ingest tweets at all; instead use the dataset only as a signal for what content to write ourselves (original articles about the top use cases); D) ingest with full attribution including 'collection source' credit to the QMuse page. Also: where should such content live on JevCode, and what Jev gate should apply per-entry?

ingest_approach.instructions: How should JevCode use the extracted 202-tweet collection?

criteria.gated_with_attribution: B: ingest only entries passing a value gate, each shown with author attribution + link to original tweet; write our own zh summaries instead of copying their machine translations
criteria.full_replication: A: replicate all 202 entries verbatim including their zh machine translations (fastest, closest to operator request)
criteria.signal_only: C: use only as research signal for writing original articles; no tweet display on site
criteria.credited_collection: D: like B but also credit the QMuse collection page as the discovery source

value_gate.instructions: If ingesting: what per-entry value gate should apply?

criteria.views_threshold: Engagement threshold: e.g. views >= 10000 or likes >= 100
criteria.jev_per_entry: Jev judgment per entry: relevance-to-developers noul + quality score + categorization choice (fan-out, one request for the whole batch per ~40 entries)
criteria.has_project_link: Only entries containing a project/demo link (35 of 202 qualify)

content_placement.instructions: Where should this content live on JevCode?

criteria.community_page: New '/{lang}/community/' page: curated feed of what people build with Jev, alongside ecosystem page
criteria.merge_ecosystem: Merge into existing ecosystem page as a new 'from the community' section
criteria.blog_section: New blog/pulse section with per-entry detail pages
criteria.nowhere: Do not publish this content type

translation_handling.instructions: How to handle zh display of English tweets?

criteria.own_summaries: Write our own concise zh one-line summaries per entry (original work, no copying their translations)
criteria.show_en_only: Show original English text only, no translation
criteria.copy_their_zh: Copy the zh machine translations from the bundle (includes known mistranslations)
criteria.excerpt_en_zh_note: Show English original with a '英文原文' label; no translation attempt

refresh_strategy.instructions: Should this become part of the automated pipeline (scheduled refresh of new tweets)?

criteria.manual_batches: Manual re-harvest when operator provides a new bundle; Jev gates each batch
criteria.pipeline_extension: Extend scripts/pipeline.mjs with a community-refresh stage (source: operator-provided bundles, since X API is not free)
